name: Archify 校验式图表
description: 把 Archify（Apache-2.0）的图表引擎装进 PI-Desktop：agent 写 Typed JSON IR，内置 CLI 跑 validate / deliver / 浏览器门禁，产出可分享的单个 HTML（架构、流程、时序、数据流、状态、ERD、类图、树、时间线、瀑布，共 10 类 + 一页式解释）。带命令面板命令与自更新。与 Excalidraw 画布共用 diagrams/ 目录。

commands.title: Archify: 校验最新候选 JSON
Archify: 打开最新 HTML 成品

agentTools.name: archify_types
agentTools.description: List Archify's diagram types with when-to-use guidance, plus the absolute paths of the bundled SKILL/references/examples/schemas runtime. Call this first when the user wants an architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle/state, ERD, class, tree, timeline or waterfall diagram, or a one-page explainer — Archify renders validated standalone HTML, unlike a hand-drawn canvas.

agentTools.name: archify_examples
agentTools.description: List the JSON-IR example files shipped with Archify (optionally for one diagram type) so you can read their exact shape before writing a candidate. Returns absolute paths.

type.description: Optional diagram type filter, e.g. architecture.

agentTools.name: archify_validate
agentTools.description: Validate an Archify candidate JSON against its schema and layout rules without producing output. Returns machine-readable diagnostics with `subject` and `supportedFixes` — fix only those objects, never rewrite the whole diagram.

candidate.description: Candidate JSON path, relative to the workspace root.

agentTools.name: archify_finalize
agentTools.description: Run the full Archify delivery gate (validate → deliver → strict check → real-browser check) and atomically write the standalone HTML. A passing result is the only proof the artifact is good; on failure read `diagnostics` and repair the named objects only (bounded to two focused rounds).

candidate.description: Candidate JSON path, relative to the workspace root.

output.description: Output HTML path, relative to the workspace root (put it under diagrams/).

quality.description: Layout quality bar. Default showcase; use standard for dense schemas.

en.name: Archify Validated Diagrams
en.description: Bundles the Apache-2.0 Archify engine: the agent authors Typed JSON IR, a zero-dependency CLI runs schema, layout, HTML and real-browser gates, and the result is one standalone interactive HTML (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle, ERD, class, tree, timeline, waterfall, plus one-page explainers). Ships command-palette commands (doctor, validate/finalize the newest candidate, open the newest HTML) and self-update from this repo's latest.json. Shares diagrams/ with the Excalidraw canvas.
en.safetyNotes: The bundled CLI runs as a local Node child process against the open workspace. It writes only the output path you pass, and the plugin refuses any output outside diagrams/. Self-update downloads only the URL listed for this plugin in this repo's latest.json (host-gated to the declared net.domains), verifies sha256 and size, unpacks a store-only .piplug, backs up the current files to the OS temp dir and then replaces them; node_modules is never touched. Archify is Apache-2.0, vendored unmodified under runtime/ with its LICENSE and NOTICE.

zh-CN.name: Archify 校验式图表
zh-CN.description: 内置 Apache-2.0 的 Archify 引擎：agent 写 Typed JSON IR，零依赖 CLI 跑 Schema、布局、HTML 与真实浏览器四道门禁，产出单个可交互 HTML（架构 / 流程 / 时序 / 数据流 / 状态 / ERD / 类图 / 树 / 时间线 / 瀑布，以及一页式解释）。带命令面板命令（自检、校验/出图最新候选、打开最新成品）与从本仓库 latest.json 自更新。与 Excalidraw 画布共用 diagrams/ 目录。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 内置 CLI 以本机 Node 子进程运行、作用于当前工作区，只写你传入的那个输出路径，且插件会拒绝 diagrams/ 之外的输出。自更新只下载本仓库 latest.json 里属于本插件的那条 URL（受 manifest.net.domains 约束的宿主网关），校验 sha256 与大小，解 store-only .piplug，先备份当前文件到系统临时目录再替换，不动 node_modules。Archify 为 Apache-2.0，runtime/ 下为未修改的原始分发，附 LICENSE 与 NOTICE。
